input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== backend now =="; try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/health' -TimeoutSec 10; "health => $($h.status)" } catch { "health ERR => $($_.Exception.Message)" }; try { $c = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/companies' -TimeoutSec 20; "companies => $([int]$c.Count) rows" } catch { "companies ERR => $($_.Exception.Message)" }; echo "== frontend now =="; try { $f = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://localhost:8080/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "root => HTTP $($f.StatusCode) len=$($f.Content.Length)" } catch { "root ERR => $($_.Exception.Message)" }; echo "== listeners =="; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8080,8082,5432 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $pr=Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "  $($_.LocalPort) <- $($pr.ProcessName) pid=$($_.OwningProcess)" } | Sort-Object -Unique
